objective: 蒸馏优秀中文字设计中的条件化决策，包括强调主笔后检测不平衡、补偿或否决；以新字对照和人类审美验证，而非几何数值或漂亮单图宣布成功。

provenance.observed_method: 强化对应位置的左侧撇笔后，如果左下重心失衡，调整另一处上方横笔并重新审查宽高。
provenance.evidence_scope: 实际阅读网页正文；原文所嵌GIF独立文件未能下载，不声称逐帧看过。
provenance.source_license: Arphic Public License via Make Me a Hanzi

design_rule.trigger: 单个新字具有几何上独立的左下行主笔与上方长横
design_rule.action: 左撇尝试有界强化；若像素重心向左偏移，则以该字另一横笔尝试有限补偿。任何结构被破坏或不符合上下文，都应拒绝。
design_rule.auto_selection: From pinned median data require main dx<-0.34 glyph bbox width & dy<-0.4 bbox height; compensator dx>0.36 width, |dy|<0.18 bbox height and starts in upper >48% bbox.
design_rule.negative_control: 飞 -> ABSTAIN: no independent matching main and upper horizontal, not forcibly reshaped.
design_rule.key_distinction: Simple causal-geometry proof of a designer's conditional corrective action, NOT reconstruction of the designer's own lettering skill.

exploratory_calibration.note: The 92%/89% refer only to restoring the X physical ink centroid after an artificial modification; not art-quality increase.

independent_holdout.important_limitation: These two glyphs also both have similar top-horizontal plus left-descending stroke structure, so the outcome cannot prove broad generalization to unrelated structural families.
independent_holdout.visual_aesthetics: No visible premium-artistic improvement over the original base identified in actual A/B/C inspection; no human blind review.

next_action: Do not tune minor geometric width or cap parameters again. Study one authentic structural authoring decision that changes internal component layout/negative space, then render a genuinely different unseen word and obtain independent quality review.
cost_incurred: No new paid design software or external paid image API invoked for this R8 experiment

cross_operator_router.source: R7 shared-left 氵 motif and R8 paired left gesture
cross_operator_router.rule: If R7 shared radical verified, do not additionally apply R8. Else R8 requires source-backed independent main+upper cross stroke. Missing metadata -> abstain.
cross_operator_router.pass: 6/6 deterministic consistency cases, including forced collision, no double styling
cross_operator_router.limitations: Policy ordering is a new engineering safety rule, not claimed historical designer preference. Hand-curated cases; no visual aesthetics or model-learning proof.
